item.text: C6’s only leaking route was route-8; Popukar deployed after that enemy had passed [4,7]. I’ll deploy Popukar at f1350 and Steward at f1710, using the same total DP and retaining the later formation and skills.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=src python - <<'PY'
import json
from scripts.kimi_readonly_tools import ReadOnlyQueryEngine
q=ReadOnlyQueryEngine()
for oid,tile,direction,targets in [('char_281_popka',[4,7],'LEFT',[[4,6],[4,7]]),('char_210_stward',[5,6],'DOWN',[[3,5],[4,6],[4,7]]),('char_120_hibisc',[5,7],'DOWN',[[4,6],[4,7],[4,8]])]:
 r=q.query_range_coverage({'operator_id':oid,'configuration':q.operators[oid]['debug_configuration'],'tile':tile,'direction':direction,'targets':[{'label':str(t),'tile':t} for t in targets]})
 print(json.dumps({'operator_id':oid,'targets':r['targets']}))
p=json.load(open('output/r8_1_gpt_tactical_batch_v1/r8_1_c6_cli/llm_structured_output.json'))['revised_operational_plans'][0]
a=[{'operator_id':x['operator_id'],'frame':x['frame'],'assume_ready':True} for x in p['action_timeline'] if x['action_type']=='ACTIVATE_SKILL']
r=q.check_timing_constraints({'skill_activations':a})
print(json.dumps({'skill_conflicts':r['conflicts'],'boundary':'first readiness assumed; repeat intervals checked; deployments only reordered'}))
PY"
